name: skills-paper
description: Research-paper lifecycle skills for GeoAI / deep-learning / GPR projects: plan, find gaps, write (Ge-style), review, and maintain docs.

plugins.name: ai-paper
plugins.description: Write DL/GPR/geophysics/remote-sensing papers or sections in Ge-style; preserves headings and inserts 'Yet to be developed' for unfinished work. Skills: `ai-paper`.

plugins.name: arch-paper
plugins.description: Write archaeological GPR papers or sections in Goodman house style; five-tier interpretation discipline; 'Yet to be developed' for unfinished work. Skills: `arch-paper`.

plugins.name: seismo-report
plugins.description: Turn seismological data (event analysis, waveforms, FAS / response spectra, source parameters, ground-motion simulation, FWI, ambient noise, GPR-seismic comparison) into a chapter-wise, publication-quality interpretation report with a formal title page and MD/HTML/LaTeX-PDF/DOCX output (Times New Roman 12pt, 1.15 spacing, styled heading hierarchy); 'Yet to be developed' for unfinished work. Skills: `seismo-report`.

plugins.name: paper-reviewer
plugins.description: Analyze academic paper PDFs from a journal reviewer's perspective and generate a comprehensive review report. Skills: `review`.

plugins.name: research-gap
plugins.description: Identify research gaps from uploaded papers/links and generate novel research project proposals. Skills: `research-gapmkl`.

plugins.name: compose-plan
plugins.description: Generate structured development plans for geophysics, GPR, seismic, and AI/ML scientific-computing projects. Skills: `compose-plan`.

plugins.name: doc-tools
plugins.description: Read, maintain, update, and explain research/project documentation (.md/.txt/.pdf/.doc/.xls). Skills: `doc-readermkl`, `documentation-agent`, `md-updater`, `methods-read-doc`.

plugins.name: ppt-mkl
plugins.description: Build research presentations from a paper or methods section: one deck source renders to PPTX with native editable equations, plus Beamer PDF, .tex and Markdown. Skills: `ppt-mkl`.

plugins.name: note-makingmkl
plugins.description: Turn source notes (Word .docx, Markdown, PDF, scanned pages) into a tight, black-and-white LaTeX -> PDF teaching-notes document: clean section/subsection hierarchy, bounded KEY POINT / NOTE / RESULT / DEFINITION boxes, wrapping tables, in-flow figures, page numbers, native equations, and a completeness audit. Skills: `note-makingmkl`.

plugins.name: ppt-to-pptx
plugins.description: Restyle/rebuild an existing PowerPoint (.pptx) into a clean styled deck (slide-for-slide, nothing left behind). Mode A: MKL lecture style with native OMML equations via ppt-mkl. Mode B: source-format-preserving — keep exact source fonts/sizes/word-colours, change only the layout (two-column: text left, figures right), re-author text screenshots as real runs, rebuild tables natively, verify with check-agents. Skills: `ppt-to-pptx-restyle`.
